exposure: time required to transfer women from labor ward to operating table
outcome: perspectives regarding the choice of Trial Of Labor After Cesarean (TOLAC)
cohort: The participants were 333 obstetricians involved in the field of labor and delivery in Greece, who responded to an online questionnaire.
finding: Obstetricians and healthcare providers in Greece are generally willing to offer TOLAC as an option, provided specific safety criteria are met, though their acceptance and practice can vary.
mod_finding: Most obstetricians are neutral or willing to perform a planned TOLAC, but those who had a failed TOLAC were more negative, and willingness increased with minimal transfer time to the operating table.
